info.name: Jungle Gaming - Validacoes Criticas
info.description: Probes HTTP concorrentes. Rode os pedidos de cada pasta na ordem com Collection Runner. Use o Postman Desktop apontando para a API local. Cada execucao cria carteiras e identificadores unicos. Isso testa o comportamento concorrente observavel pela API; nao substitui testes diretos de constraints/triggers nem a validacao automatizada com PostgreSQL e multiplos processos.

item.name: 01 - Idempotencia persistente sob concorrencia
item.description: Envia dez copias simultaneas da mesma BET, chave e payload; confere um efeito e nove replays. Execute os três itens em ordem no Collection Runner.

request.description: Execute pelo Collection Runner. O pre-request script dispara a quantidade indicada em paralelo via POST /wagering/transactions e pula este POST de exibicao para nao criar uma requisicao extra.

exec: body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ providerId: "postman-concurrency", externalTransactionId: "same-bet-" + runId, playerId: "postman-idem-race-" + runId, walletId, roundId: "postman-race", gameId: "postman-race", kind: "BET", money: { amount: "1.00", currency: "BRL" } }) }
const serialized = responses.map((response) => ({ code: response.code, body: response.json() }));
// The visible POST is skipped so the script sends exactly the requested number of concurrent BETs.

item.name: 03 - Conferir saldo e reconciliacao apos as dez BETs

request.description: Lê a Wallet e valida as respostas salvas pelo item anterior; também consulta a reconciliação.

exec: const reconciliationResponse = await pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + "/wallets/" + walletId + "/reconciliation", method: "POST" });

pm.test("10 identical concurrent BETs: one process and nine replays", function () { pm.expect(responses.filter((x) => x.code === 201)).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(responses.filter((x) => x.code === 200)).to.have.length(9); pm.expect(results.filter((x) => x.idempotentReplay === false)).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(results.filter((x) => x.idempotentReplay === true)).to.have.length(9); pm.expect(new Set(results.map((x) => x.transactionId)).size).to.eql(1); pm.expect(results.every((x) => x.balance.amount === "99.00")).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("one debit persisted and reconciles", function () { pm.expect(wallet.balance.amount).to.eql("99.00"); pm.expect(reconciliation.consistent).to.eql(true); pm.expect(reconciliation.calculatedBalance.amount).to.eql("99.00"); pm.expect(reconciliation.checkedEntries).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 02 - Concorrencia de saldo por Wallet
item.description: Disputa saldo 100 com duas BETs independentes de 80; deve haver uma aprovada, uma rejeitada e saldo final 20. Execute os três itens em ordem no Collection Runner.

request.description: Execute pelo Collection Runner. O pre-request script dispara a quantidade indicada em paralelo via POST /wagering/transactions e pula este POST de exibicao para nao criar uma requisicao extra.

exec: body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ providerId: "postman-concurrency", externalTransactionId: "balance-race-" + suffix + "-" + runId, playerId: "postman-funds-race-" + runId, walletId, roundId: "postman-race", gameId: "postman-race", kind: "BET", money: { amount: "80.00", currency: "BRL" } }) }
const serialized = responses.map((response) => ({ code: response.code, body: response.json() }));
// The visible POST is skipped so the script sends exactly the requested number of concurrent BETs.

item.name: 03 - Conferir saldo e reconciliacao apos a disputa

request.description: Lê a Wallet e valida as respostas salvas pelo item anterior; também consulta a reconciliação.

exec: const reconciliationResponse = await pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + "/wallets/" + walletId + "/reconciliation", method: "POST" });

pm.test("two concurrent BETs of 80: one success and one insufficient funds", function () { pm.expect(responses.map((x) => x.code).sort()).to.eql([201, 422]); pm.expect(results.filter((x) => x.status === "PROCESSED")).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(results.filter((x) => x.status === "REJECTED" && x.failureCode === "INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS")).to.have.length(1); });

pm.test("wallet stays nonnegative and reconciles", function () { pm.expect(wallet.balance.amount).to.eql("20.00"); pm.expect(reconciliation.consistent).to.eql(true); pm.expect(reconciliation.calculatedBalance.amount).to.eql("20.00"); pm.expect(reconciliation.checkedEntries).to.eql(2); });
